description: Chengdu Jikong (JK) battery management systems: protection settings, cell voltages, alarms, state of charge, identification and commands over RS485 Modbus
source: JK BMS RS485 Modbus general protocol V1.1 (2024-02)

sources.title: BMS RS485 Modbus general protocol V1.1

notes: Modbus RTU over RS-485, 115200 bps 8N1, address 1 to 247; functions 03 (read) and 10 (write multiple) only.

The map is in four blocks: settings at 0x1000, live data at 0x1200, identification at 0x1400 and commands at 0x1600. The manual lists an 'index' in bytes for each item, and the register address is the block address plus that index (the examples show writing the second 32-bit setting at 0x1004 with a count of 2). A 32-bit value takes two registers, so the next item is four addresses further on.
Where the manual lists two one-byte items in one two-byte entry, the first byte is taken as the high byte of the register.
The alarm word is 32 bits with the high word first, so alarm bits 0 to 15 are in the second register and bits 16 to 21 in the first.
Settings are in millivolts, milliamps, seconds or 0.1 °C as given; the manual's examples show 2.83 V written as 2830.
Left out: the protocol-selection and trigger-source bytes of the identification block (0x00B2 and later) and the single-byte smart sleep time and data-enable bytes at 0x1118.
Written from the manufacturer's manual (Chinese); not tested on a device.
